title: Exploded View

usage: Attach the photo; the command flattens perspective and cleans shadows.

/Scan

title: 100x Upscale
description: Aggressively upscale a tiny or degraded image while inventing plausible detail.
usage: Attach the low-res source and state how faithful the result must stay.
example:
/100xUpscale
Image: old_avatar.jpg
Fidelity: keep facial identity
Output: 4096px PNG

title: Summarize Anything

usage: Paste the text and set the target length and audience.
example:

usage: Name the concept and your current level.
example:

Level: junior developer

usage: Paste your current prompt and what went wrong with the output.
example:

Problem: output is generic
Goal: expert-level, 900 words

title: Code Review

usage: Paste the diff or file and mention the language and constraints.
